| [CLAIM-471](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md) v3 | Physical interconnection can generate effective constraints on joint behaviour; measurement can establish correspondences among local descriptions; and adaptive apparatuses can revise those correspondences; gluing expresses compatibility under specified relations, but neither the relations' physical generation nor their adequacy follows from gluing alone | The owner's U20 of the exchange of 2026-10-27, "interactions generate constraints that manifest as gluing conditions between intertial frames", restated at the owner's review.
